What CRI has: 1,81,000 solar pumping systems commissioned. A Rs.320 crore MSEDCL empanelment for 10,714 pumps under Magel Tyala Saur Krushi Pump. 15 minutes?

Hi,

Quick note on timing, because this one has a date on it.

MNRE's office memorandum of 28 March 2026 extended PM-KUSUM Phase 1 to 31 March 2027 - but only for projects with PPAs or NTPs issued by 31 December 2025. For Component B and Component C individual pump solarisation, commissioning is due 30 September 2026. MNRE has indicated this is the final blanket relief; anything further is case-by-case. PM-KUSUM 2.0 has not been formally notified.

So the clock is real, it is public, and it is roughly two weeks out.

CRI is MNRE-empanelled, holds a Rs.320 crore MSEDCL award for 10,714 pumps, and has commissioned 1,81,000 systems nationwide with IoT monitoring and a five-year warranty. No competitor in this category can match that installed base.

And right now the page your ~56 live ads point at contains one photograph.

The fix list is short: a real solar page with HP-wise pricing and post-subsidy farmer share, the deadline stated plainly, WhatsApp plus Marathi, Hindi and Tamil creative, and 1,81,000 pumps as the headline instead of a press release nobody reads.
